basic_details.job_title: CSU Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 5 Centre Coordinator, Technical Expert and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Central Sanskrit University (CSU), New Delhi, has invited online applications for Centre Coordinator and four Vertical Expert posts (one position each) in the Gyan Bhartam Cell of the Cluster Centre at CSU, under a MoU with Gyan Bhartam, Ministry of Culture. The engagement is contractual for 11 months (purely temporary and project based), with fixed monthly remuneration of ₹60,000 for the Centre Coordinator and ₹40,000 for each Expert. Applications are accepted online at csu.co.in/gyanbhartam until 30 November 2026, 11:30 PM (IST).

important_dates.interview_date: To be notified on www.sanskrit.nic.in under the "RECRUITMENT" tab

how_to_apply: The notice asks for online applications only. The link for submission is https://csu.co.in/gyanbhartam/. Candidates must submit the application with all requisite documents/attachments by 30 November 2026, 11:30 PM (IST). The notice does not list the individual documents or describe the form-filling steps.
For any technical problem during registration or online application submission, candidates can write to [email protected].
All requisite documents/attachments, uploaded with the online application.
No-Objection Certificate from the current employer, if currently employed, to be furnished at the time of reporting for the Skill Test/Interview.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the Skill Test and Interview. If a candidate fails to appear for the Skill Test and/or Interview for any reason, the University is not responsible. CSU reserves the right to reject any application without assigning any reason. CSU reserves the right to terminate the engagement at any time, even before the stipulated time, without assigning any reason. The project staff positions are co-terminus with the Project.

content_sections.heading: About CSU
content_sections.text: Central Sanskrit University is established by an Act of Parliament, 2020, and is located at 56-57, Institutional Area, Janakpuri, New Delhi-110058. This recruitment follows a MoU between Gyan Bhartam, Ministry of Culture, Delhi and the University for hiring a Centre Coordinator and Vertical Experts in the Gyan Bhartam Cell of the Cluster/Independent Centre. The positions serve the activities under the Gyan Bhartam Project.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: CSU has announced 5 positions in total, one for each post. The University reserves the right to increase or decrease the vacancies according to circumstances. Reservation (SC/ST/OBC/PWD/EWS) applies as per CSU/Govt. of India rules on the subject. The notice prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Each post has its own qualification and experience requirement, given below exactly as printed in the notice. Postgraduate degree in Manuscriptology/Sanskrit/Indology/Library & Information Science/Archival Studies/Conservation Science or an allied discipline from a recognized university. Minimum 10 years of professional experience in manuscript cataloguing and documentation, curation and collection management, and editing and transcription. Knowledge of ancient Indian scripts. Proven ability to lead a team. Adequate computer proficiency for documentation, reporting and data management. Desirable: (a) demonstrated experience in handling ancient and rare manuscripts; (b) exposure to national or institutional manuscript missions or projects. Master's degree in Sanskrit/Pali/Prakrit/Linguistics/Manuscriptology, OR Master's degree in History/Archaeology/Library & Information Science with Diploma/PG Diploma in Manuscriptology or Conservation. AND minimum 5 years' experience in manuscript survey, cataloguing, preservation and transcription. Knowledge of regional scripts and languages preferred. Master's degree in Science (with Chemistry as a Subject at Graduation Level), OR Master's degree in Fine Arts/Visual Arts, OR Master's degree in Art Conservation/History/Archaeology/Museology or equivalent subject. AND minimum 5 years' experience in manuscript preservation and conservation. Proven ability to lead a team and computer skills. Adequate computer proficiency for documentation, reporting and data management. Formal training in Conservation of Manuscripts and Art objects from a reputed National level institution, such as National Research Laboratory for Conservation of Cultural Property (NRLC). The training period must be not less than six (06) months. Graduate degree in Computer Science or MCA, OR PG Diploma in Computer Science. Minimum 2 years' experience in manuscript handling, digital imaging, metadata and data management. Knowledge of scripts will be an added advantage. Master's degree in Sanskrit/Pali/Prakrit/History/Urdu/Persian, or in any one of the languages mentioned in the Eighth Schedule of Constitution. Expertise in any one Language and Script viz. Brahmi, Sarda, Grantha, Bengali, Odia, Telugu, Tamil, etc. AND at least 5 years of experience in script reading, decoding and translation, editing. Capable for editorial and documentation support. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Centre Coordinator receives ₹60,000 per month and each of the four Expert posts ₹40,000 per month as fixed remuneration. The positions are purely contractual for 11 months or until completion of the Project, whichever is earlier, and are co-terminus with the Project. No other compensation apart from the consolidated remuneration is admissible, even if the candidate attends the office on holidays or works beyond normal office hours. Contract staff are not entitled to Confirmation, LTC, Medical reimbursement or other benefits admissible to regular University employees.

content_sections.heading: CSU Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Ensure academic verification of the authenticity of data pertaining to all 5 verticals of Gyan Bharatam. Coordinate effectively with the concerned department and Nodal Officer at State/UT and district level for implementation of Gyan Bharatam. Ensure coordination with staff of all verticals at the centre and good team management. Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports of work done by the Centre and forward them to Gyan Bharatam. Monitor proper fund utilization by the Centre, forwarding financial progress and timely UC to Gyan Bharatam. Coordinate closely with Gyan Bharatam to achieve the targets set for the centre, and act as focal point for all coordination with Gyan Bharatam. Monitoring of functions and discharge of the Centre Coordinator's responsibilities will be done by Gyan Bharatam. Provide overall leadership and supervision of survey operations within the assigned jurisdiction. Serve as the primary liaison between Gyan Bharatam authorities, survey teams and partner institutions. Ensure all metadata entries are accurate and conform to GB-approved standards. Review and validate the quality of images, geo-tags and completeness of survey data. Ensure comprehensive geo-tagging of all manuscripts and repositories surveyed. Monitor progress and maintain updates on the Centralized GB Dashboard. Maintain a dedicated channel for reporting operational challenges or emergencies. Submit regular weekly and monthly progress reports to Gyan Bharatam. Conduct surveys and assessments of Partner Centres to evaluate infrastructure, collections and preparedness. Identify and prioritize manuscripts requiring conservation and digitization, in alignment with GB protocols. Coordinate closely with conservation teams of the Cluster Centre and Partner Centres for timely and standardized execution of approved activities. Compile and submit weekly and monthly progress reports to the Cluster Coordinator, detailing assessments, conservation status, digitization readiness and operational challenges. Submit periodic status reports to Gyan Bharatam and ensure compliance with GB digitization standards. Supervise safe manuscript handling and coordinate troubleshooting with the Centre Supervisor. Ensure digitization at minimum 400 DPI (true optical resolution) using face-up scanning technology. Digitization workflow: manuscript preparation and handling; high-resolution image capture; metadata creation and validation. Conduct first-level quality checks before submission as per a checklist covering: faithful image reproduction; correct file naming and formats; proper bit depth and resolution; clean edges, contrast and legibility; no skewing, distortion or artifacts; correct page order, rotation and margins; no broken or truncated figures; absence of moiré patterns; no pixilation; balanced exposure; no loss of detail in highlights or shadows; complete, accurate and validated metadata for each manuscript. Ensure digital images meet the technical standards of GB, MoC. Submit

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only candidates found eligible and shortlisted under the prescribed eligibility criteria and other applicable provisions will be called for the Skill Test and/or Interview, as applicable. The schedule will also be notified in due course on www.sanskrit.nic.in under the "RECRUITMENT" tab; no separate communication will be made through any other mode unless otherwise specified.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 positions in total: one each for Centre Coordinator, Survey & Cataloguing Expert, Conservation Expert, Technical Expert (Technology & Digitization) and Script and Language Expert. CSU may increase or decrease the vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CSU Gyan Bhartam posts?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026 at 11:30 PM (IST). Applications must be submitted online with all requisite documents/attachments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Centre Coordinator post?
faq.answer: A Postgraduate degree in Manuscriptology/Sanskrit/Indology/Library & Information Science/Archival Studies/Conservation Science or an allied discipline from a recognized university, plus minimum 10 years of professional experience in manuscript cataloguing and documentation, curation and collection management, and editing and transcription.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Technical Expert (Technology & Digitization) post?
faq.answer: A Graduate degree in Computer Science or MCA, OR a PG Diploma in Computer Science, with minimum 2 years' experience in manuscript handling, digital imaging, metadata and data management.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for CSU Gyan Bhartam posts?
faq.answer: The Centre Coordinator gets a fixed ₹60,000 per month. The Survey & Cataloguing, Conservation, Technical and Script and Language Experts get a fixed ₹40,000 per month each.

faq.answer: Apply online through the link at https://csu.co.in/gyanbhartam/, with all requisite documents/attachments, by 30 November 2026, 11:30 PM (IST). Technical problems can be reported to [email protected].

faq.answer: Eligible and shortlisted candidates will be called for a Skill Test and/or Interview, as applicable, followed by document verification. Details will be sent by registered email at least one week before the date.
